ios.desc:
Every project begins with some form of documentation, whether it's notes on paper or digital files.
These documents are then transferred to a to-do list.

However, we can simplify this process by creating a platform where you can create to-do lists, take notes, and more.
Additionally, we can include the option to organize everything into nested pages.
Furthermore, we can allow you to view all your to-dos on a single page, sorted by date.
Lastly, collaborating with others is always easier, so we can add the feature to share pages with anyone.

That is FlowNote.
